claims.text: NYT Magazine 11 Jul 2025 (110+ officials, government records): Netanyahu prolonged the war for political survival; shelved a truce that would have freed at least 30 hostages after Smotrich threatened to topple the government; derailed Saudi normalization tied to ending the war after Ben-Gvir's opposition. PMO: coverage 'defames Israel…'; NYT: statement 'does not refute the facts'.

Hagari 19 Jun 2024 (Channel 13): 'Hamas cannot be destroyed. Hamas is an idea'; 'If we don't bring something else to Gaza, we will end up with Hamas again.' PMO: cabinet defined destruction of Hamas's military and governing capabilities as a war goal.

Leaked IDF intelligence database (Guardian/+972/Local Call): by May 2025 8,900 Hamas and PIJ fighters confirmed or probably dead vs at least 53,000 total deaths = ~17% named fighters, ~83% civilians; IDF said figures 'incorrect' without specifying.
Blinken 14 Jan 2025: Hamas had recruited almost as many new fighters as it lost; cannot be defeated by 'a military campaign alone'.

Washington Post 21 Dec 2023: evidence 'falls short of showing that Hamas had been using the hospital as a command and control center'; tunnel rooms showed no immediate evidence of military use; none of five identified buildings connected to tunnels; US backed Israel's assessment.

OIOS Aug 2024 on 19 UNRWA staff alleged by Israel: 9 may have been involved in 7 October, 9 insufficient evidence, 1 no evidence; OIOS could not independently authenticate most of Israel's information.
Guardian Sept 2025: IDF database identifies only about one in four Gaza detainees as fighters; most held without charge are civilians.
Oct 2023: Israel mobilized ~360,000 reservists, 300,000 in 48 hours, ~4% of population.
Sinwar killed 16 Oct 2024 in a chance encounter by troops on routine patrol in Rafah, not a targeted operation; Israel did not know his exact location.
10 Apr 2026: Netanyahu asked to delay corruption-trial testimony citing classified security and diplomatic reasons; trial since 2020 repeatedly delayed.
30 Nov 2025: Netanyahu asked President Herzog for a pardon; Trump had written to Herzog urging one; charges bribery, fraud, breach of trust; lawyers cite need for unity after war.

Ben-Gvir quit in January 2025 over the ceasefire and returned after strikes resumed 18 March 2025 (400+ killed), strengthening coalition before a budget vote; Netanyahu: 'only the beginning', war aims destroying Hamas and freeing hostages.
HRW Nov 2023: al-Ahli hospital blast resulted from 'an apparent rocket-propelled munition, such as those commonly used by Palestinian armed groups'; reported 471 dead an 'unusually high' ratio.
Sept 2024: pager attacks 17 Sept, Nasrallah killed 27 Sept; within about ten days Israel removed much of Hezbollah's chain of command.
8 hostages rescued alive by military operations (Megidish Oct 2023; 2 Rafah Feb 2024; 4 Nuseirat Jun 2024; Alkadi Aug 2024).
Of 251 hostages, 168 returned alive: 4 released Oct 2023, 105 in Nov 2023 truce, 33 Jan–Mar 2025, Edan Alexander May 2025, 20 on 13 Oct 2025, the rest by rescue.
Nuseirat rescue 8 Jun 2024: Gaza health ministry said at least 274 Palestinians killed, ~700 wounded.

+972/Local Call Apr 2024: Lavender marked up to 37,000 Palestinians; ~10% error; ~20 seconds human review; early-war allowance of 15–20 civilian deaths per junior operative; 'Where's Daddy?' home tracking; IDF: 'auxiliary tools'.
Netanyahu May 2024: '14,000 have been killed, combatants, and probably around 16,000 civilians.'
Jan 2026: unnamed senior IDF official said army estimates ~70,000+ dead and at least 22,000 combatants killed; IDF said details 'do not reflect official IDF data'.
IDF spokesman Nadav Shoshani called the Guardian detainee report 'based on numerous inaccuracies'; most suspects found involved in terrorist activity after interrogation; others released.
ICC: Israel's challenge to the court's jurisdiction remained pending after the Appeals Chamber remitted it; leave to appeal refused Oct 2025.
